source: User delegated case selection from an existing private repository. The three briefs are agent-proposed real candidates, not synthetic captures or completed human labels.

privateManifest.access: Private operator evidence store; never resolve by fetching private contents into the public repository.

missingInputs: Case-specific operator outcome labels with author/time before evaluation
Approved private-source exposure to the selected 9Router route and provider policy
Pinned harness, router endpoint reference, execution profile, budgets and stop mechanism
Exact runnable checks/prerequisites and private starting-commit mapping frozen into a registered fixture

cases.intendedOutcome: Evaluate and prepare the narrowly scoped package-manager CI action update while preserving immutable pins and the selected package-manager version. Separate existing dependency-audit failures from regressions introduced by this update.
cases.scope: Only the two existing action references and their version comments; necessary verification evidence. No dependency refresh, workflow permission expansion, audit suppression or unrelated CI changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Both intended action references use the same reviewed immutable revision.
Selected Node/package-manager versions and the dependency lock remain unchanged.
Changed-action behavior is verified in the selected isolated CI-equivalent environment; existing failures are compared against the same starting dependency graph.
Report every unresolved verification failure; do not call the update merge-ready while repository-required gates fail.
requiredChecks: Review the exact action diff and upstream release changes.
Run the repository immutable-action-pin check and workflow lint in the isolated environment.
Compare dependency manifests and lockfile between the registered base and candidate.
Run frozen dependency installation and the required security audit at both revisions with matching tooling/advisory evidence.
Run required CI gates or record platform/network blockers explicitly.
cases.feasibilityReason: Smallest candidate and recommended first harness task once route/private-source permissions and a bounded execution profile are registered. Existing CI failures prevent a green-readiness claim.
cases.expectedResponse: Produce the narrow reviewed update and a failure-attribution report. Escalate inherited security blockers without suppressing them or silently expanding dependency scope.
cases.capture: Evaluate and fix selected existing pull requests in the operator-selected private repository (redacted paraphrase).

repository.prerequisites: Exact revisions, commands, toolchain and CI evidence are retained in the private manifest. No repository scripts executed on the host.

dataPermissions.externalEffects: No merge, deployment, account changes or public disclosure of private artifacts.

cases.intendedOutcome: Evaluate and prepare a patch-level Swift runtime update while retaining unrelated platform dependency pins and generated-client consistency.
cases.scope: The selected Swift dependency declaration and resolver-owned lock update only; do not manually patch generated clients or change application behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the intended runtime version changes semantically.
Unrelated platform dependencies remain correctly resolved on the required platform.
Generated-client drift checks and Swift package tests pass.
Required native platform checks run on an available supported toolchain, or their unavailability is stated without a compatibility claim.
requiredChecks: Review manifest and complete lock diff, including removed pins.
Resolve dependencies using the registered supported native toolchain.
Run existing generated-client consistency check and Swift package tests.
Run required native build/test and repository gates in an authorized environment.
cases.feasibilityReason: Bounded change, but the proposed lock update also removes unrelated platform pins. Native-platform resolver/build evidence is required; a Linux-only run cannot establish native compatibility.
cases.expectedResponse: Preserve platform lock completeness, prepare the patch, and report exact checks plus platform blockers. Do not treat a nominal patch version as proof of compatibility.

cases.intendedOutcome: Assess a grouped JavaScript development-tool update, identify changes compatible with the pinned runtime/framework, and produce a bounded keep/split/defer recommendation with a React Doctor baseline.
cases.scope: Dependency compatibility analysis and a proposed minimal subset. Major toolchain migrations and application/styling rewrites are outside this case. Implementation of a selected subset requires a newly frozen brief.
acceptanceCriteria: Every grouped change is assigned a compatibility decision supported by its runtime/framework constraints.
Baseline failures are distinguished from candidate-introduced failures.
React Doctor runs with a pinned version and full scope; findings are triaged as evidence, not automatically treated as confirmed defects.
Recommend an explicit minimal subset or defer the group, without weakening tests or migrating the existing styling system.
requiredChecks: Compare grouped manifest/lock changes against pinned runtime and framework constraints.
Run pinned React Doctor in a read-only, network-isolated source environment and retain its full report privately.
Register base/candidate web lint, typecheck, unit test and build comparisons for any selected subset.
Record remaining security and native-platform gates separately.
cases.feasibilityReason: Feasible as a bounded diagnosis after registration. The grouped update contains major changes and cannot be accepted as a routine bump without broader migration scope. A static Doctor preflight exists privately; it is not an evaluated harness result.
cases.expectedResponse: Return a compatibility matrix, triaged static findings and a minimal follow-up brief. Do not silently implement all major upgrades.
